What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `hash2`: Boost.Hash2 1.92: its headers (boost/hash2/) state no constant-time property.

The default of `digests::blake2b` is `sodium`, whose cell comes with a later increment: until then a call on the default stops at compile time, and a call names a backend of the table (<<hash-default-backend>>).

The default of `digests::blake2s_256` and `macs::blake2s_mac`: `hash2` on every target, whatever the program links (<<hash-default-backend>>).
